subject: The confession I wasn't going to send about your meetings
preview_text: What your last 30 days could have looked like versus what they actually were. This changes everything.
body_paragraphs: I need to confess something. I looked at my calendar from 30 days ago and had a moment of pure panic. I saw a wall of back-to-back meetings with zero memory of what was decided in half of them. Sound familiar? That was my life before this app.

Here's the brutal truth. Without Smart Notes, your last 30 days were a blur of frantic scribbling, missed action items, and that sinking feeling you forgot something important. You were physically in meetings but mentally scrambling to capture it all. With it? You'd have a searchable archive of every decision, a clear list of your commitments, and 5+ hours of your life back. That's not a guess—it's what our users report.

The difference isn't magic. It's the AI summary feature working in the background. While you listen and engage, it builds a perfect cheat sheet. No more reconstructing meetings from memory. You just open the app and the clarity is already there, waiting for you.

Open the app right now. Tap into your last meeting. Read the AI summary. Feel that relief? That's your new normal starting today. P.S. The users who do this for 3 meetings in a row never go back. They can't afford to.
